question: In Linear: Rename the doc Maya Chen created for the Growth initiative to "Growth Q4 plan".
final:
Done. Renamed the doc Maya Chen created for the Growth initiative (was "Q4 planning draft", d-1) to **"Growth Q4 plan"** — verified the title in Linear.

Note: Maya had three docs; only d-1 ("Q4 planning draft") belongs to the Growth initiative — "Retention ideas" is in the Retention initiative and "Referral launch plan" is tied to the Referral program project, so I left those untouched.
